title: 14 第14章 风暴15 第15章 天香坊
content_zh:
无边无际的太行山脉，充满了原始的气息，各种高大树木，奇山峻岭分布在其中。
虎啸猿啼，凶禽猛兽，层出不穷。
然而，在这险峻的山林之中，一道看似瘦弱的身影时常出现，猎杀了不少野兽。
“靠，点背啊！”
这人影一剑刺穿一头双角野山猪，然后稳稳的落在地上，“好好的蛇形果竟然被这畜生吃了一半！”
这人影正是林轩，他气愤的将那对白色的双角割下，收入背包之中。
这几天他一直在山林之中，为的就是寻找蛇形果和紫花地丁，经过几天的努力，他已经找到的三枚蛇形果和四株紫花地丁，只要每种凑够五个，就能让酒爷酿制可以提升修为的酒了。
就在刚才，他好不容易找到了一枚蛇形果，结果被一只双角野猪抢先啃了半口。
气愤之下，林轩只好解决了这双角野猪。
还差两枚蛇行果和一株紫花地丁，要抓紧时间了！
林轩身形晃动，再次出发。
离内门考核只剩下两个月了，可他的实力还在凝脉境三阶。
林轩如同大鸟一样，脚尖一点，在空中滑翔，等到降落时在借助树枝发力，使得他整个人都在半空中。
这蛇形果喜欢阴暗潮湿，而紫花地丁则喜欢太阳，所以林轩只能四处奔波。
呼！
他灵巧的落在一个大树的树干之上，眼神如电光般向四周扫去，果然一处阴暗的地方发现了蛇形果。
不得不说，林轩的运气还算好的。
这蛇形果虽然不算十分珍贵，但也是不常见，再加上玄天宗的长老们用量很大，所以附近的蛇形果被摘的也差不多了。
林轩脚掌一跺，身子飞向蛇形果附近，还未落地，草丛之中，突然起了变化。
一条双尾的青蛇如利剑一般窜起，蛇嘴长成扇形，直接咬向林轩的头部。

“找死！”
林轩一声怒喝，黑铁长剑斜刺而出，快似闪电，正好刺中七寸之处。
手腕一翻，灵力灌注剑身，那股力量顿时将伤口撕开，如同发生了爆炸一样。
一剑解决了双尾青蛇，林轩快速的抓向那蛇形果。
刚一入手，他便感到一股危机感传来。
他疯狂的运转长生诀，整个手掌泛起青色光芒，如同一轮皓月。
嗤嗤！
两道尖锐的声音响起，那蛇形果的叶子下面藏着两条手指长短的小蛇，在林轩手掌落下的一瞬间便咬了上去。
好在林轩反应够快，要不然肯定会被咬伤。
别看这种蛇体型小，但是毒性却非常大，一般凝脉六阶以下的只要被它咬一口，不死也得半残。
林轩直接发力震死两条小毒蛇，然后摘下蛇形果，最后把那双尾蛇的蛇胆也取出，一块放入了背包。
“这些材料怎么着也能卖点灵石，不过背包快满了，放不下了啊！”
林轩看着剩下的材料，眼中全是不舍，那可都是灵石啊。
“你个土包子，这点东西都舍不得！”
酒爷嘲讽的声音响起。
“酒鬼大叔，不是说好在说话前要先打招呼的吗。”
林轩有些抓狂，竟然被一个酒鬼鄙视了。
“嗯，我还没想好怎么打招呼呢，又不能让我敲门。”
酒爷翻了翻白眼，“你还是太年轻，像我就完全能适应在你体内的日子。”
“靠！”

林轩恨不得钻进去揍他一顿，不过为了灵酒和雷动剑法的修炼，他忍了。
content_en:
The boundless Taihang Mountains are full of primitive atmosphere, with all kinds of tall trees and strange mountains scattered among them.
Tigers roar, apes cry, and ferocious birds and beasts emerge in endlessly.
However, in this steep mountain forest, a seemingly thin figure often appears and hunts many wild beasts.
"Fuck, hold your back!"
The figure pierced a double-horned wild boar with his sword, and then landed firmly on the ground. "The good snake-shaped fruit was half eaten by this beast!"
This figure was Lin Xuan. He angrily cut off the pair of white horns and put them in his backpack.
He has been in the mountains and forests for the past few days, looking for snake-shaped fruits and purple-flowered stalks. After several days of hard work, he has found three snake-shaped fruits and four purple-flowered stalks. As long as he collects five of each, the wine master can brew wine that can improve his cultivation.
Just now, he finally found a snake-shaped fruit, but a two-horned wild boar took a bite of it first.
In anger, Lin Xuan had no choice but to deal with the two-horned wild boar.
There are still two snake berries and a purple lilac plant left, so hurry up!
Lin Xuan shook his figure and set off again.
There are only two months left before the inner sect examination, but his strength is still at the third level of Pulse Condensation Realm.
Lin Xuan was like a big bird, gliding in the air on his tiptoes. When he landed, he used the branches to exert force, keeping him in mid-air.
The snake-shaped fruit likes darkness and humidity, while the purple-flowered groundworm likes the sun, so Lin Xuan can only run around.
call!
He deftly landed on the trunk of a big tree, his eyes swept around like lightning, and sure enough, he found a snake-shaped fruit in a dark place.
I have to say that Lin Xuan's luck is pretty good.
Although this snake-shaped fruit is not very precious, it is also uncommon. In addition, the elders of Xuantian Sect use a lot of it, so almost all the snake-shaped fruits nearby are picked.
Lin Xuan stomped his feet and flew towards the snake-shaped fruit. Before he landed, something suddenly changed in the grass.
A green snake with two tails sprang up like a sharp sword, its mouth grew into a fan shape, and bit directly towards Lin Xuan's head.
"Seeking death!"
Lin Xuan shouted angrily, and the long black iron sword thrust out diagonally, as fast as lightning, and hit just seven inches.
With a flip of his wrist, spiritual power poured into the sword, and the force immediately tore open the wound, as if there was an explosion.
After killing the two-tailed green snake with one sword, Lin Xuan quickly grabbed the snake-shaped fruit.
As soon as he got it, he felt a sense of crisis.
He was running the Immortality Secret crazily, and his entire palm glowed with cyan light, like a bright moon.
Tsk!
Two sharp sounds sounded. There were two small snakes as long as fingers hidden under the leaves of the snake-shaped fruit. They bit Lin Xuan's palm the moment it fell.
Fortunately, Lin Xuan reacted quickly enough, otherwise he would definitely have been bitten.
Although this kind of snake is small in size, it is very poisonous. Generally, if a person below the sixth level of pulse condensation is bitten by it, he will not die but will be half disabled.
Lin Xuan used his force to kill the two small venomous snakes, then picked off the snake-shaped fruit, and finally took out the gallbladder of the twin-tailed snake and put it into his backpack together.
"I can sell some spiritual stones with these materials, but my backpack is almost full and I can't put it in anymore!"
Lin Xuan looked at the remaining materials with reluctance in his eyes. They were all spiritual stones.
"You country bumpkin, you can't bear to part with this little thing!"
The wine master's mocking voice sounded.
"Uncle Drunkard, didn't you agree to say hello before speaking?"
Lin Xuan was a little crazy, being despised by a drunkard.
"Well, I haven't figured out how to say hello yet, and I can't be allowed to knock on the door."
The wine man rolled his eyes and said, "You are still too young. Like me, you can completely adapt to being in your body."
"Fuck!"
Lin Xuan wanted to get in and beat him up, but he endured it for the sake of practicing Lingjiu and Lei Dong sword skills.
